name: Kurumba Maldives
notes: Source: Wikipedia (Kurumba Maldives), resortlife.travel, kurumba.com, maldives-magazine.com review, WTM Global Hub / Maldives Magazine / edition.mv / see.mv rebrand coverage (Oct 2025). Confirmed island name Vihamanaafushi, North Male Atoll (Kaafu, code K), operator Universal Resorts, 5-star, 180 rooms. Multiple 2025/2026-dated sources describe an in-progress corporate rebrand: Universal Resorts' management arm is becoming 'VERSA Hospitality' and this property is being renamed 'Niva Kurumba Maldives', effective 31 March 2026 (booking.com and TripAdvisor already list it as 'Niva Kurumba Maldives'). Confirmed no overwater villas (deliberate positioning choice per multiple sources, citing ground-level bungalow/pool-villa categories instead).

name: Soneva Fushi
notes: Source: Forbes Travel Guide, Scott Dunn, Amex Travel, TripAdvisor, soneva.com, LuxAtolls, theworlds50best.com. Confirmed island name Kunfunadhoo, Baa Atoll (code B), operator Soneva Management (BVI) Limited, opened 1999. Villa/room count cited as '64 villas' (one source said 'approx. 63'); 64 used. All-inclusive confirmed via the resort's own 'Soneva Unlimited' all-inclusive program. Overwater villas confirmed ('8 Water Reserves' plus water-villa categories). Several marketing/review sources describe it informally as a '7-star' resort; this is not an official hotel-star classification (the standard scale tops out at 5), so star_rating was left null rather than recorded as 7.

name: Velassaru Maldives
notes: Source: Kuoni, Maldives Magazine ('NIVA Velassaru Maldives Review 2025'), Trivago, Wikipedia (Kaafu Atoll), WTM Global Hub / edition.mv rebrand coverage. Confirmed island name Velassaru, South Male Atoll (part of Kaafu administrative atoll, code K), operator Universal Resorts, opened 1974, 5-star per Maldives Magazine, has water villas. As with Kurumba, this property is being rebranded 'Niva Velassaru Maldives' effective 15 January 2026 under Universal Resorts' new 'VERSA Hospitality' management arm; some listings already show the Niva name. Room count not found in a specific, confidently-sourced figure, left null.

name: Six Senses Laamu
notes: Source: Virtuoso, Mr & Mrs Smith, Amex Travel, PADI Travel, sixsenses.com, Michelin Guide, overwaterbungalows.net, TripAdvisor (property listed under 'Olhuveli Island'). Confirmed island name Olhuveli, Laamu Atoll (code L; described as the only resort in the atoll), operated/branded by Six Senses. 94 total villas cited, of which 73 are water villas (overwater_villas confirmed true). All-inclusive status ambiguous across sources (available as an all-inclusive package through some travel agents, but the resort's own model is described as multi-restaurant a la carte); left null rather than guessing. Star rating not found stated for this specific property in an authoritative snippet (Six Senses as a brand is widely described as luxury/5-star, but that was not treated as confirmation for this property), left null.

name: Baros Maldives
notes: Source: Kuoni, Africa Odyssey, baros.com, Island Travel Maldives, SLH (Small Luxury Hotels of the World), foratravel.com, asiaodysseytravel.com, myhoneymoonhotel.com. Confirmed island name Baros (the resort takes its name from its own island), North Male Atoll (code K), open since 1973, 75 rooms, overwater 'Water Villas' confirmed. Star rating: consistently described as 5-star (one marketing source speculatively claimed it 'may qualify for 6-star'; 5-star used as the more consistently corroborated figure). Search results describe Baros as independently run/managed rather than part of a named hotel group; no parent operator company was found, so operator_name left null rather than guessed. It is a Small Luxury Hotels of the World (SLH) marketing-consortium member, which is not the same as an owning/operating company.

name: Gili Lankanfushi
notes: Source: Lightfoot Travel, Black Tomato, Amex Travel, gili-lankanfushi.com, Mahlatini, TripAdvisor, breakingtravelnews.com, true5stars.com, rocketreach.co (management team). Confirmed island name Lankanfushi, North Male Atoll (code K), 45 villas, all built overwater on stilts (overwater_villas true), described as 5-star. Operator is unresolved/conflicting: recent (2025) press describes the resort operating independently with its own GM/leadership appointments and no named parent company, while a separate (undated, likely older) article headline states 'HPL Hotels & Resorts takes over at Gili Lankanfushi'; the resort was also formerly associated with the Soneva brand under a previous name (Soneva Gili) before becoming independent. Given this conflict, operator_name left null rather than picking one. All-inclusive status not stated in sources reviewed, left null.

name: Arena Beach Hotel
notes: Source: TripAdvisor, Orbitz, momondo, islandtravelmaldives.com, hotels-maldives.net. Confirmed as a real beachfront hotel on Maafushi Island, Kaafu Atoll (code K), self-described/listed as a 4-star property (TripAdvisor rating 4/5). Room count conflicting across sources (136 per Orbitz/Kayak vs. 233 per another aggregator) and could not be resolved with confidence, so left null. No confirmed operator/parent company name or official website found via search; both left null rather than guessed. No basis found to confirm or deny overwater villas, left null (guesthouse-class properties on inhabited local islands are not generally licensed for overwater structures, but this was not individually confirmed for this property, so it was not filled in as a guess).

name: Kaani Beach Hotel
notes: Source: Hotels.com, TripAdvisor, HotelsCombined, reserving.com, kaanibeach-hotel-maafushi.h-rez.com, kayak.com. Confirmed real beachfront hotel on Maafushi Island, Kaafu Atoll (code K), 18 rooms/accommodations. Search summaries describe it as part of the 'Kaani Hotels' group (which also runs Kaani Grand Seaview and Kaani Palm Beach, both also on Maafushi) but did not surface a formal registered company name for that group, so 'Kaani Hotels' is recorded as a brand-level operator name with lower confidence than the resort operators above; flagged in Known Gaps. Star rating conflicting (self-described as 4-star per one source, 3-star per another booking aggregator) so left null. No official website URL confirmed.

name: Go Surf Maldives
notes: Source: go-surf.site (property's own site, returned directly in search results), nomadsurfers.com, Airbnb, Travalo/Planet of Hotels listings, maldivestour.guide island guide. Confirmed as a real surf guesthouse on Thulusdhoo Island, Kaafu Atoll (code K), a well-documented surf-tourism island (home to the 'Cokes' surf break). No confirmed room count, star rating, operator company, or all-inclusive/overwater status found in the snippets reviewed; left null rather than guessed.

name: SeaLaVie Inn
notes: Source: ukulhasmaldives.com (dedicated island-guide site with a hotel-specific review page), corroborated by general Ukulhas guesthouse-listing search results. Confirmed as a small 5-room guesthouse on Ukulhas Island, Alif Alif Atoll (code AA), described consistently as a well-rated, home-style small guesthouse. No confirmed star rating, operator company, official website, or all-inclusive/overwater status; left null.

name: Whaleshark Beach
notes: Source: trip.com, amaldives.com guesthouse page, tophotelsmaldives.com / themaldiveshotels.com listings, dreamingofmaldives.com 'where to stay for whale sharks' guide. Confirmed as a real 23-room guesthouse on Dhigurah Island, Alif Dhaalu / South Ari Atoll (code ADh), an island well known for whale-shark and manta excursions. No confirmed star rating, operator company, official website, or all-inclusive/overwater status; left null.

name: Dhaankolhu Rasdhoo
notes: Source: amaldives.com dedicated guesthouse page ('an inviting 9-room guesthouse on Rasdhoo Island, North Ari Atoll'). Confirmed real 9-room guesthouse on Rasdhoo Island, Alif Alif / North Ari Atoll (code AA; Rasdhoo is the atoll capital). No confirmed star rating, operator company, official website, or all-inclusive/overwater status; left null. Several other real guesthouses were also identified on Rasdhoo during research (Ras Rana Lodge, Ras Atoll Inn, Rasdu View Inn, Rasdhoo Island Inn Beach Front, Rasdhoo Dive Lodge) but were not individually added to keep the dataset from being padded with under-verified duplicates of the same island.

name: Crystal View Maldives Guest House
notes: Source: TripAdvisor ('Crystal View Maldives Guest House', Gulhi Island), travala.com, planetofhotels.com, viaggio.com Gulhi guesthouse listings. Confirmed as a real guesthouse on Gulhi Island, Kaafu Atoll (code K). One search snippet described a similarly-named 'Crystal View Palace' as a '2-star guest house' in Kaafu Gulhi, but it is unclear whether this is the same property as 'Crystal View Maldives Guest House' or a distinct, similarly-branded one, so star_rating was left null rather than risk attaching an unverified rating to the wrong property (see Known Gaps in SOURCES.md). Room count, operator, website, all-inclusive and overwater status all left null.

name: Coral Grand Beach & Spa
notes: Source: Hotels.com, Booking.com, TripAdvisor (including a user review titled 'Not a 4 star hotel'), Travelocity, LateRooms.com, trip.com, maldiveshotel24.com. Confirmed as a real hotel on Hulhumale Island, Male City (code MLE), 20 rooms. Star rating explicitly conflicting across booking platforms (listed as both 3-star and 4-star, and one guest review directly disputes the 4-star classification), so left null rather than picking one. No confirmed operator company or official website found; left null. All-inclusive/overwater status not applicable/not found; left null.
